stem: When the author brought the flower seeds home, her mother reacted in a way that —

options.label: A
options.text: forced the author to seek help elsewhere

options.label: B
options.text: showed she was pleased by the author’s attempt to care for the seeds

options.label: C
options.text: demonstrated her lack of interest in the author’s hobbies

options.label: D
options.text: showed she expected the author to be responsible for the care of the seeds
